senses.gloss:
बव बव, अम्, n., N. of the first Karaṇa
or astrological division of the day; (also written
वव; see under करण.)

बावादेव बावा-देव, अस्, m., N. of the
author of the Arpaṇa-mīmāṃsā, a treatise on sacri-
ficial rites.

बावा-शास्त्रिन्, ई, m., N. of the author of the
Svarodaya-vivaraṇa, q. v.
